name: Cron explainer
author: friday-core
description: Parses a five-field cron expression (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week, with ranges, steps, lists, names and @daily style macros), says in plain words when it runs and lists the next runs in a time zone offset you choose (default UTC). Follows standard cron: when both day fields are set, either one matches. Rejects an invalid expression with the reason.
